name: zip_slip_dotdot
intent: Zip-slip: an entry that climbs out of the extraction root.

name: zip_slip_nested_dotdot
intent: Zip-slip that only escapes after normalising the middle segments.

name: zip_slip_backslash
intent: Zip-slip with a Windows separator: a reader that converts \ to / extracts outside the root.

name: backslash_inside_name
intent: A backslash anywhere in a name is refused, not converted (the rules of #427 7.1).

name: absolute_unix
intent: Absolute path.

name: absolute_drive_letter
intent: Drive-letter absolute path.

name: drive_relative
intent: Drive-relative path (no slash after the colon).

name: unc_path
intent: UNC path.

name: trailing_dot_name
intent: Windows strips a trailing dot, so this name becomes index.html and can shadow it.

name: trailing_space_name
intent: Windows strips a trailing space, same shadowing as the trailing dot.

name: name_too_long
intent: A 304-character name (cap 255).

name: path_too_deep
intent: 25 nested directories (cap 20).

name: device_name_con
intent: Windows device name: opening it hangs or writes to a device.

name: device_name_nul_txt
intent: Windows device name: opening it hangs or writes to a device.

name: device_name_aux_html
intent: Windows device name: opening it hangs or writes to a device.

name: device_name_com1_js
intent: Windows device name: opening it hangs or writes to a device.

name: device_name_lpt9
intent: Windows device name: opening it hangs or writes to a device.

name: local_name_differs_from_central
intent: The central directory says index2.html, the local header says ../evil.js: a reader that streams local headers extracts outside the root, one that reads the directory sees a safe name.
notes: The reader must compare both names (or only trust one consistently) and refuse a mismatch.

name: percent_encoded_dotdot_is_a_literal_name
intent: A name that contains %2e%2e%2f is an ordinary file name: it must be stored literally and never URL-decoded into ../.
notes: Also guards the package host: the stored key must stay literal when the request path is decoded once.

name: bomb_ratio_one_entry
intent: One entry of 64 MB zeros deflates to about 64 KB (ratio ~1000:1; cap 100:1 per entry).
notes: Needs a test cap of at most 100:1 per entry and the 64 MB entry under the total cap, so only the ratio rule can fire.

name: bomb_total_many_entries
intent: Twenty entries of 8 MB zeros: each is under the ratio-limited cap on its own, the total (160 MB) exceeds a total cap of 100 MB.
notes: Needs a test total cap of at most 100 MB; the ratio is also over, so the reader must report too_large first (total before ratio) or the test must set the ratio cap above 1000:1.

name: bomb_lying_header
intent: The headers say 100 bytes, the deflate stream is 50 MB: counting header sizes passes it, counting real bytes does not.
notes: Needs a test total cap of at most 40 MB. 'Never trust headers': real bytes decide.

name: too_many_entries
intent: 12 000 empty files (cap 10 000).

name: zip64_declared_huge
intent: A Zip64 entry whose extra field claims 6 GB while the real data is 5 bytes: 64-bit counters must be read, and a size over the cap refused.
notes: A reader that rejects header/real mismatches may report too_large as well; the intended reason is the cap check on the 64-bit value.

name: zip64_valid_small
intent: A valid package written with Zip64 extra fields and a Zip64 end record: the reader must use 64-bit counters and still accept it.

name: data_descriptor_streamed
intent: A valid package whose entries use a data descriptor (sizes 0 in the local header): the reader must not trust local-header sizes.

name: symlink_entry
intent: A Unix symlink (mode 0120777) whose content is the target path.
notes: ZIP has no hardlink entry type; hardlinks only exist in tar, which is rejected as a nested archive.

name: encrypted_entry
intent: General-purpose flag bit 0 (traditional PKWARE encryption) on an entry.

name: executable_exe
intent: A .exe file (executable or server-side script).

intent: A .dll file (executable or server-side script).

intent: A .php file (executable or server-side script).

intent: A .cmd file (executable or server-side script).

name: executable_ps1
intent: A .ps1 file (executable or server-side script).

name: executable_upper_case_extension
intent: RUN.ExE: the extension check is case-insensitive.

name: nested_archive_zip
intent: A nested .zip archive (never extracted; v1 rejects it).

name: nested_archive_jar
intent: A nested .jar archive (never extracted; v1 rejects it).

name: nested_archive_war
intent: A nested .war archive (never extracted; v1 rejects it).

name: nested_archive_7z
intent: A nested .7z archive (never extracted; v1 rejects it).

name: nested_archive_rar
intent: A nested .rar archive (never extracted; v1 rejects it).

name: nested_archive_tar
intent: A nested .tar archive (never extracted; v1 rejects it).

name: nested_archive_gz
intent: A nested .gz archive (never extracted; v1 rejects it).

name: nested_archive_tgz
intent: A nested .tgz archive (never extracted; v1 rejects it).

name: duplicate_exact
intent: The same name twice: which one wins depends on the reader (a later one can overwrite the validated one).

name: duplicate_case_fold
intent: index.html and INDEX.HTML collide on a case-insensitive store.

name: duplicate_nfc_nfd
intent: café.html written once in NFC (é = U+00E9) and once in NFD (e + U+0301): different bytes, same name after normalisation.

name: duplicate_in_directory_case
intent: dir/A.js and DIR/a.js: the collision is in a directory segment, not the file name.

name: name_bidi_override
intent: U+202E (right-to-left override) in a name: exe.js displays as sj.exe.

name: name_control_character
intent: U+0001 in a name.

name: name_bom
intent: U+FEFF (byte order mark) at the start of a name.

name: name_nul_byte
intent: A NUL byte inside a name: C-string readers see a shorter name than the validator.

name: name_invalid_utf8_with_flag
intent: Bit 11 says UTF-8 but the bytes 0xFF 0xFE are not valid UTF-8.

name: name_cp437_accented
intent: A name in CP437 without the UTF-8 flag (byte 0x82 is é): decoded as CP437, not rejected and not read as invalid UTF-8.
notes: The stored key is the decoded name café.html.

name: name_utf8_accented
intent: A name with the UTF-8 flag (é as two bytes).

name: not_a_zip_random_bytes
intent: Random bytes with a .zip name.

name: empty_file
intent: Zero bytes.

name: empty_archive
intent: A valid zip with no entries.

name: truncated_archive
intent: A valid package cut in the middle of the central directory.
notes: Raw file, not a readable zip.

name: no_manifest
intent: A zip without imsmanifest.xml or h5p.json.

name: polyglot_html_and_zip
intent: An HTML document in front of the zip data (an HTML+ZIP polyglot): the zip is read from the end and the archive is accepted; the prefix is never served.
notes: A reader that scans from the start for local headers must reach the same entries.

name: polyglot_entry_content_types
intent: index.html that starts with GIF89a, and logo.gif that contains HTML: the stored type comes from the extension allow-list, never from the bytes or the zip.
notes: Served as text/html and image/gif respectively, with nosniff.

name: svg_with_script
intent: An SVG that contains a script: active content, served with the sandbox CSP and as an attachment on top-level navigation.

name: scorm12_valid
intent: A valid single-SCO SCORM 1.2 package.

name: scorm2004_valid
intent: A valid single-SCO SCORM 2004 4th edition package.

name: xxe_file_entity
intent: A DOCTYPE with an external file entity used in the title (DTD processing is prohibited).

name: xxe_http_entity
intent: A DOCTYPE with an external http entity: the validator must never open a connection.
notes: The integration test runs a loopback listener on port 9 and asserts it never gets a request.

name: xml_billion_laughs
intent: Exponential entity expansion (a billion laughs): ~1 GB of text from a 1 KB file.

name: doctype_without_entities
intent: A bare DOCTYPE: DTD processing is prohibited outright, not only entity expansion.

name: manifest_not_xml
intent: A manifest that is not XML.

name: manifest_huge
intent: A 3 MB manifest (document size cap).

name: manifest_launch_file_missing
intent: The launch href names a file that is not in the package.

name: manifest_href_parent_escape
intent: A launch href that climbs out of the package (and could select another package's file).

name: manifest_href_absolute_url
intent: A launch href that is an absolute http URL.

name: manifest_href_file_scheme
intent: A launch href with the file: scheme.

name: manifest_href_javascript_scheme
intent: A launch href with the javascript: scheme.

name: manifest_href_backslash
intent: A launch href with a backslash.

name: manifest_href_protocol_relative
intent: A protocol-relative launch href.

name: multi_sco
intent: A manifest with two SCOs and two items (multi-SCO courses are out of v1).

name: scorm2004_sequencing
intent: SCORM 2004 simple sequencing rules (imsss:sequencing) that the v1 runtime does not implement.

name: manifest_schema_location_and_xml_base_never_fetched
intent: xsi:schemaLocation and xml:base pointing at a loopback URL: the validator must not fetch anything and must resolve the href against the package root.
notes: The integration test runs a loopback listener on port 9 and asserts it never gets a request.

name: xml_base_hides_missing_launch_file
intent: The launch file exists only if xml:base is honoured (it is not in the package): the href is resolved against the package root, so the file is missing.

name: manifest_utf8_bom
intent: A manifest that starts with a UTF-8 byte order mark.

name: launch_frameset
intent: A launch page that is a frameset (the SCO sits in a child frame that looks in parent for the API).

name: launch_iframe_to_local_page
intent: A launch page whose only content is an iframe of another page of the package.

name: html_utf8_bom
intent: A launch page with a UTF-8 BOM: the injector must insert after the BOM, not before it.

name: html_meta_charset_latin1
intent: A page declared as windows-1252 with a non-ASCII byte (0xE9): re-encoding through UTF-8 would corrupt it.

name: html_utf16le_bom
intent: A UTF-16 LE page with a BOM: decode, inject, re-encode as declared.

name: html_utf16be_bom
intent: A UTF-16 BE page with a BOM.

name: html_no_head
intent: A page with <html> and <body> but no <head>.

name: html_no_html_no_head
intent: A page that is a bare fragment (no <html>, no <head>).

name: html_doctype_and_comments_first
intent: A doctype and comments (one containing the text <head>) before <html>.

name: html_uppercase_and_attributes
intent: <HEAD profile="x"> in upper case with an attribute.

name: html_head_text_in_script
intent: The string "<head>" inside a script before the real <head> closes.

name: html_conditional_comment
intent: An IE conditional comment before <head>.

name: scorm_multipage_sco
intent: A SCO of three pages linked to each other (page1 → page2 → page3): the API must be available on every page, with the state kept across navigations.
notes: Every HTML response of the package gets the prelude, not only the launch page.

name: sco_defines_its_own_window_api
intent: The SCO defines window.API itself (an offline-mode stub) before looking for one.

name: sco_catches_the_parent_walk_error
intent: The SCO walks window.parent for the API and catches the SecurityError (opaque origin) instead of crashing.

name: sco_reads_initial_state_synchronously
intent: The SCO reads cmi.core.lesson_status right after LMSInitialize with no port handshake yet.

name: sco_touches_storage
intent: localStorage, sessionStorage, document.cookie and indexedDB inside the sandbox (S2 b): each must throw or be a stand-in, never reach the app's data.

name: sco_xhr_own_host
intent: An XHR to a file of its own package (S2 c): needs connect-src 'self' and CORS from an opaque origin.

name: sco_fetch_outside
intent: fetch() to an outside URL and to the app origin with credentials (must fail: connect-src 'self', no cookies).

name: sco_navigates_top
intent: top.location = an outside URL (sandbox without allow-top-navigation).

name: sco_navigates_itself_outside
intent: location.href = an outside URL: the frame's own navigation, blocked by the app's frame-src.

name: sco_meta_refresh_outside
intent: <meta http-equiv=refresh> to an outside URL: a navigation with no script, also blocked by frame-src.

name: sco_opens_popup
intent: window.open() (sandbox without allow-popups).

name: sco_submits_form
intent: A form that auto-submits to an outside URL (form-action 'none'; allow-forms is dropped).

name: sco_forges_postmessage
intent: Posts forged commit messages to the parent window (the app must trust only the private port).

name: sco_uses_eval
intent: eval() and new Function(): needs 'unsafe-eval' (S3), blocked by the strict CSP.

name: sco_inline_handler_and_blob_worker
intent: An inline event handler and a blob: worker (script-src 'unsafe-inline', blob: workers).

name: sco_external_font_and_script
intent: A web font and a script from a CDN (must be blocked: no external origins).

name: h5p_valid_minimal
intent: A structurally valid H5P file (h5p.json, content.json, one library).

name: h5p_missing_json
intent: A package with content/ and a library but no h5p.json.

name: h5p_json_not_json
intent: h5p.json is not JSON.

name: h5p_json_deeply_nested
intent: content.json nested 200 levels deep (depth cap 32).

name: h5p_json_huge
intent: content.json of 2 MB (cap 1 MB).

name: h5p_main_library_traversal
intent: mainLibrary and a dependency machineName that are paths (../../x).

name: h5p_library_with_php
intent: A server-side script inside a library folder.
